raw_rows.bundle_payload_note: Each decision row embeds the FULL evaluated evidence bundle (typed view granted to that method) plus the predicate evaluation trace; auditors reconstruct every decision without re-running classification.

validation_rules.timings_positive: every wall/cpu duration > 0 for executed work; zero/placeholder => schema FAIL
validation_rules.keys_unique: (system,construction,seed,arm,repeat_id,context) unique for outcomes; (system,construction,seed,method,branch) unique for decisions
validation_rules.provenance_present: no decision row without embedded bundle payload + predicate trace
validation_rules.mcnemar_only_paired_secondary: z-test columns rejected at parse time
validation_rules.freeze_binding: final runner refuses to execute unless freeze_guard passes: clean tree, frozen input hashes match, freeze SHA reachable on origin
